tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i sgrub thabs bzlas lung las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ rgyal sras thugs rje'i dbang phyug ni// nam mkha'i snying po la btud nas// nad mtshon mu ge'i 'jigs pa dag /zhi phyir lhag pa'i lha de bsgrub// sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ rang gi snying gar kham̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid nam mkha'i snying po sku mdog sngon po na bza' sngon po can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon pas pad+ma'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na ral gri sngo sangs can/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi khang bzang 'od zer sngon po 'bar ba'i dbus na/ khro bo dbyug sngon sogs 'khor rig 'dzin mtshon cha thogs pa mang po dang*/ rang gi sprul pa kha dog sna tshogs can mang pos bskor ba/ spyan gyi 'od kyis nam mkha' thams cad 'od dang dri zhim pos khyab par mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ gi bar kun tu bzang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ oṃ swa sti ka mā lāk+ṣi/ bi pu la/ saṃ bha wa/ dharma dhā tu/ go tsa re swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o// rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ thun mtshams kyang kun tu bzang po'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya klog pa nyid khyad par ro// 'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul ni/ 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o// nyes ltung kun nas dag mdzad pa'i// yi dam 'di 'dra mchog tu dga'// mtshan brgya'i man ngag snying po ni// zur du bkol ba 'di tsam yin// paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phags pa nam mkha' snying po sgrub thabs kyi le'u mtshan no// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ ā pirta de sha na bi dhi/ bod skad du/ ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/

btsun pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dag 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes ltung gi tshogs ci mchis pa de dag thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ btsun pa'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// mi 'chab bo// mthol zhing bshags na/ bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na de ltar mi 'gyur ba lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas mthong sdom dris la thabs yin no// legs so zhes brjod do// dang por sbyor ba'i cho ga ni/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas kyi nyon mongs pa mang ba'am/ bag med pa la sogs pa'i stobs kyis nyes ltung gi tshogs mang po bdog ste mchi bas/ de dag dge 'dun gyi spyan sngar bshags par 'tshal bas thugs kyi gzung 'tshal zhes pa dang mjug ltung ba las bslang ba shin tu bka' drin che lags zhes pa dang*/ chos bzhin du mdzad pa rjes su yi rang zhes brjod par bya'o// ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// ༈ /nam snying bshags chog gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs in+d+ra nī la'i phreng ba bzhugs so// ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad dpal// rnam grol lam gyi sa mkhan nyi ma'i gnyen// sa bcu'i dbang phyug nam mkha'i snying po la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i byin rlabs stsol// rnal 'byor ma dpal shākya rak+ṣi ta// bud+dha swā mī slob dpon legs skyes zhabs// sā dhu dzñā na saṃ pra kīrti la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i byin rlabs stsol// be dā ban+dhu dpa' ba'i bshes gnyen dang*// pūr+ṇa badz+ra rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon// nyid sprul rgyal tshab rgya mtsho rnam gnyis la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i byin rlabs stsol// kun bzang dbang po tshe dbang nor bu mchog

/phrin las shing rta chos kyi nyi ma dang*// phrin las rnam rgyal pad+ma nyin byed la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i byin rlabs stsol// smin grol bdud rtsi'i bcud mchog stsol mdzad pa// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i byin rlabs stsol// thog med nas bsags las nyon sdig sgrib dang*// khyad par byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las// gsungs pa'i bslab byar 'gal nyams gang gyur pa// mun la nyi bzhin yud kyis byang bar shog /dngos sam rmi lam nyid du 'phags pa'i zhal// dngos su mthong nas thugs rje'i phyag brkyang ste// sgrib pa kun bsal lam mchog bgrod pa'i thabs// ston cing dag pa'i sa la dbugs dbyung shog /'thabs rtsod mu ge mi ngas la sogs pa// rnyogs ldan zhing gi rnam 'gyur kun zhi zhing*// rigs dang blo gros tshe dang longs spyod sogs// dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar shog /mkha' khyab 'gro drug gnas su mtshan gyi sgras// khyab cing thugs rje can zhal mthong ba yi// skal pa bzang ldan kun kyang rgyal sras che'i// rnam thar bsam mi khyab la 'jug gyur cig /ces pa'ang lung rtogs kyi bdag nyid ser rtsa mchog gi sprul pa'i skus mdo chog nyams bzhes skabs gsung bskul ngor blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spungs gdan sar sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i bzlas lung sgrub thabs ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phags pa'i lam gyi shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sems dpa' nyi ma'i shing rta'i 'gros ldan pa// rgyu skar bye ba'i dbus na nyi ma'i dpal// brgya byin thogs dbus nor bu'i cod pan gyis/ mtshon mdzad sa bcu'i dbang phyug de la 'dud// srid pa gsum du mtshan tsam yang*// brgya lam thob dka'i rin po che// nam mkha'i snying po la brten nas// ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga bri// de la lnga/

dgos ched kyis khog bkrol/ nyams len snod rung du bsgrub/ bsnyen pa'i cho ga bshad/ ltung ba bshags pa bye brag tu smos/ 'phros don khyad par can brjod pa'o// dang po la gnyis lung dang lo rgyus so// dang po ni/ bod yul 'dir mu stegs byed dang nyan thos kyi theg pa kho na 'dzin pa ni ye med de/ thams cad kyang theg pa chen po la mos pas spyod cing dngos sam brgyud nas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa sha stag yin mod/ byang chub spyod pa dang ltung ba legs par 'chos pa ni ches dkon zhing*/ kha na ma tho ba chen po dang ldan pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba rnams la'ang bag med par spyod pa mang na ltung ba phra zhib dang rtag tu 'grogs pa ni lta ci smos/ 'on kyang ltung ba'i rnam grangs tsam yang mi shes pa'i dge sbyong du khas 'che ba rang nyid kyi thar pa'i lam stor ba ma zad dad pa can rnams kyi yon chud gson cing thar pa'i go gegs par byed pa ni ches mang ngo*// de'ang dpal mar me mdzad kyis/ sems can rnams la srog gces shing srog la brten pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' la'ang srog lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems gces shing de la brten pa'o// pha ma lta bu'i chos ni stong pa nyid dang snying rje yin te/ des ma bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes pas byang chub tu sems ma bskyed na theg pa chen po'i sar mi chud la/ sems bskyed pa tsam gyis mi chog bslab bya la slob cing ltung ba phyir bcos la mkhas pas bya dgos te/ sa bon btab pa tsam gyis mi chog so nam gyi bya ba la brtson dgos pa bzhin no// byang sdom gyi ngo bo gzhan don tu rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa la/ bdag rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ dmigs rkyen mdo sde sogs la brten te/ de'i mthun phyogs sgrub cing mi mthun phyogs spong bar mtshungs kyang*/ thob tshul las gsum ste/ so thar dang cho ga thun mong ba'i byang sdom/

cho ga thun mong ma yin pa'i byang sdom/ dbang bskur dang cho ga thun mong gi byang sdom mo// dang po ni/ so thar gyis sdom pa la byang chub kyis zin pa'i theg chen so thar du grags pa/ gnyis pa dbu sems kyi cho ga gang rung gis thob pa'i smon 'jug gi sdom pa/ gsum pa dbang bskur sta gon dang 'jug pa'i skabs su thob pa'i byang sdom dang dngos gzhi'i skabs thob pa'i sngags sdom rnams so// de dag las skabs su babs pa byang sdom thun min gyi cho ga la dbu sems kyi lugs gnyis su grags te/ dang po ni 'jam dbyangs nas klu sgrub yab sras la brgyud de zhi ba lha'i phyag srol jo bo puṇ+ya shrī las byung ba klu sgrub kyi sems bskyed cho ga dang*/ dze tā ri'i yi dam blang ba'i cho ga zhi ba lha'i bslab spyod sogs kyi dgongs pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ byams pa nas thogs med sku mched la brgyud de tsan+d+ra go mī'i phyag srol a ti sha las byung ba byang sa dang sdom pa nyi shu pa sogs kyi dgongs pa ste/ snga ma ni/ gtso bor rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis phyag len tu mdzad cing*/ phyi ma ni gtso bor bka' gdams pa dang mnyam med dwags brgyud pa rnams kyis phyag len tu mdzad la gnyis ka la'ang gnyis ka mnga' 'o// de dag gi bslab bya shin tu rgya che'ang mdor bsdu na gnyis/ dgag pa'i bslab bya dang sgrub pa'i bslab bya'o// dang po la gnyis/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bslab bya'o// dang po ni/ mnyam med dwags pos/ sems can gcig kyang blos mi spang*// rtag tu sems de'i phan yon bsam// tshogs gnyis bsags la brtson par bya// yang yang byang chub sems gnyis sbyang*// nag po'i chos bzhi spangs nas ni// dkar po'i chos bzhi bsten par bya// zhes pa ltar te/ 'di dag 'chor na byang sdom rtsa nas gtong ste rmang 'gyel na khang pa la brten pa mi 'ong ba bzhin no// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dbu ma lugs dang*/

sems tsam lugs so// dang po la gsum/ byang sems dbang rnon la nam snying mdo'i dgongs don bslab btus su tshigs bcad kyis bstan pa ltar rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang*/ dbang 'bring la thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo don rtsa ltung bzhi dang*/ dbang brtul la sdud pa sogs nas gsungs pa ltar byang chub kyi sems mi spang ba ste/ de spang na smon sems 'dor bas dbang po gsum ka la'ang rtsa ltung kun gyi nang nas ches lci ba yin mod/ da lta ni bdag 'dra'i dge sbyong gi gzugs brnyan phal mo che 'di nyid spong ba la brtson pa mang ste sems can gcig cig blos btang na'ang der 'gyur bar bshad pas so// yan lag gi nyes byas brgyad cu la sogs pa mtha' yas so// gnyis pa la gnyis/ byang sa'i don sdom pa nyi shu pa las tshigs bcad du gsungs pa ltar rtsa ltung bzhi/ yan lag gi nyes byas zhe drug go /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdu na pha rol phyin drug gam/ tshul khrims rnam pa gsum ste/ bslab pa blangs phyin chad bslab bya 'di dag nges par shes shing bslab dgos te/ gang las shes zhe na/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ mdo sde rnams las bslab par snang*// de bas mdo sde bklag par bya// nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo sde ni// thog ma nyid du blta bar bya// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ mdo sde spyi dang khyad par sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa/ nam snying*/ thar pa chen po'i mdo la sogs pa dang*/ tshul khrims le'u/ sdom pa nyi shu pa/ mdo btus/ byang sa/ bslab btus la sogs pa'i rgya gzhung*/ sdom gsum ston pa'i bod gzhung rnams la legs par brtags te phan yon nyes dmigs zhar la shes pas dgos pa'i skabs phyed de glen 'tham ji mi snyam du ma gyur par bya'o// bslab bya'i sdom pa nyams shing phyir bcos ma byas pas ci 'gyur snyam na/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ yul sems can/ byed po rang nyid bcas bslus pas don gnyis nyams shing kun gyis smad pa'i gnas su 'gyur/

tshe 'dir mi shis pa du ma 'byung zhing 'chi khar 'gyod pas gdung*/ phyi ma ngan 'gro mu mtha' med par ltung zhing thar bar dka'/ khyad par rtsa ltung gis ni sngon gyi dge rtsa mtha' dag 'dzad cing nges par dmyal bar skye ba dang*/ so thar srung mi nus na re zhig bslab pa 'bul ba bslab byar gsungs mod/ byang sdom 'bul na ni nyes pa ches lci bas byang sdom ma blangs na der zad blangs phyin chad bslab pa ci nus su bsrung zhing nyams na phyir bcos bya ba las thabs gzhan yod pa ma yin no// de'ang nyin mtshan cha drug tu bgos pa'i so so'i thun dang por ltung ba byung na thun de ka'i mjug tu gnyen pos sleb na tshul khrims rnam par dag par 'gyur bas bshags tshad las ma 'das na rtsa ltung yang yang byung rung bshags pas sor chud par 'gyur/ bshags tshad las 'das na bshags pa tsam gyis gso bar mi nus pas phyir bcos sngon du 'gro ba'i bslab pa bskyar dgos so// byang sdom tshang ba lta ci smos/ smon sems tsam bsrungs kyang phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste nyan thos kyi sdom pa rnam dag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srung ba'ang sems bskyed pa gcig gi phan yon gyi char mi nye ste/ dpas byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*// gal te de la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun gang ste// de ni de las lhag par 'gyur// gaṅgā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi// sangs rgyas zhing rnams mi gang gis// rin chen dag gis kun bkang ste// 'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas// gang gis thal mo sbyar bgyis te// byang chub tu ni sems btud na// mchod pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags// de la mtha' ni ma mchis so// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rwar bsdams pa'i nyams thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes sogs bka' bstan bcos las mtha' yas par gsungs pas bslab pa 'di la nan tan du bya zhing ltung ba byung na phyir bcos pa la 'bad par bya ste/

de'ang cho ga gsum so so'i rang lugs ltar dgos mod kyi byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi ltung ba gtso bor de nyid kyi theg pa las bshad pa ltar bcos dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// phung po gsum pa gdon bya zhing*// rgyal dang byang chub sems brten nas// ltung ba'i lhag ma des zhi bya// zhes spyi dang*/ khyad par mdo las/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po 'di ni snying rje chen po dang ldan pa/ sems can la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa/ sdug bsngal chen po las thar bar byed pa ste/ sems can gang dag ltung ba'i rtsa ba byung ba ngan song du 'gro ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sprug par byed pa/ 'jig par byed pa'i sems can de dag la rigs kyi bu 'di ni sman tu gyur pa'o// ma rig pa'i mun pa mun nag dang*/ lta ba ngan pas sdug bsngal bar gyur pa rnams la ni 'di nyi ma dang mtshungs pa'o// rtsa ba'i ltung ba chags su bcug pa'o// de dag gi snying la the tshom yod pa 'dral bar byed pa'o// zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs pa ltar 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po la gsol ba btab cing bshags na des sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis rtsa ba'i ltung ba la sogs pa sel bar mdzad par gsungs pas des na 'di nyid la nan tan tu 'bad par ci nas gdams so// gzhung lugs rnams su dbu ma lugs kyi phyir bcos kho na la bshad pa ltar yod kyang lugs de'i bslab bya gang las 'byung ba'i khungs dang 'brel pa tsam du dgongs kyi/ don du dbu ma lugs kyi bslab bya'i nyes ltung kho nar ma zad sangs rgyas byang sems kyi spyod yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ lhag par sdig ltung mtha' dag sel ba'i mdzad pa mnga' ba mdo la mjal bas shes nus shing*/ nag po pas/ dbang rab stong nyid kyis bshags dbang 'bring rig sngags spyi'i lha nam mkha'i snying po la bshags dbang po tha ma gang zag la'am stobs bzhi tshang bas bshags par gsungs pa'ang 'di la don gyis tshang ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/

de skad du bshad kyang mdo sde rnams la da lta gdams ngag med pas lag len byas kyang 'bras bu mi 'byin no snyam na/ spyir rgyud dang ma 'brel ba'i mdo sde phal mo che la gsang ba med pas sgra ji bzhin tu spyod pas chog pa'ang yin la/ dad brtson gyis lcogs na mthar thug 'bras bu chud mi za ba gzhir bcas/ mngon rtogs kyang nges par 'byung ste brgyad stong pa dang sdud pa la kha ton rtse gcig byas pa tsam gyis de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa mthar thug skye zhing*/ gdung ring bsrel du gyur pa mang dag byung ba dang*/ kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis thar pa chen po'i mdo'i dgongs don bzhin dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas zhag bdun gzims spangs te cho ga mdzad pas sangs rgyas nyan thos dang bcas pa gdugs tshod gsol ba'i gral du dam chos kyi bgro ba ngo mtshar ba mdzad pa'i dag snang byung ba dang*/ sman bla'i mdo chog dang gnas brtan cho ga'i byin rlabs byung tshul rgya cher lo rgyus rnams su gsal bar ma zad/ 'di la ni gdams ngag kyang yod de rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta pūr+ṇa badz+ra las rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon pos nod de bsnyen pa dang bshags chog skya rengs gsol ba gdab mdzad pas/ nub bdun gyi tha mar dag pa'i snang bar/ bod pa'i dge slong sku sha dkar ba dang yol dul nyams can/ gos chen gyi snam sbyar sngon po gsol ba zhig gis/ khyed rang da bshags pa gyis gsungs/ spyi bshags bla ma rdor 'dzin ma zhig mdzad pas/ de tsam gyis mi chog sgos bshags gyis gsungs/ ltung ba thugs la mnga' ba kha cig ming nas smos te bshags pa phul bas zhal 'dzum mdzad de/ da dag 'dug ste sāts+tsha stong phrag gcig thob gsungs gnam sgo zhig nas yar bzhud ces bka' bstsal la/ de tsam du ma zad da lta'i skabs su'ang cho ga 'di dang thar pa chen po'i mdo sogs la rang gzhan nyams su len pa na byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan gzhan zab mor brdzu ba'i 'ad 'ud can kun las che ba yid ches pa 'byung ba ni nges pa'o// gnyis pa snod rung du byed pa bzlas lung 'bogs pa ni/

sku brnyan maṇ+ḍal mchod pa sogs bshams la/ slob dpon gyis sgom bzlas tshar gcig nyams su blang*/ slob ma rnams phyag bcas mdun du 'khod pa la 'di skad ces/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du sgom bzlas kyi lung zab mo blang bar bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed cing*/ chos gsan pa'i kun spyod rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas gsan par zhu/ de yang lus can rnams kyis don du gnyer bya mthar thug pa ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kho na yin la/ de sgrub par byed pa'i thabs 'chad pa ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa dang*/ de las kyang theg pa chen po pa kho na'i khyad chos yin cing*/ de la'ang don spyi ston pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las khyad par du 'phags pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di nyid la brten nas dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' dag mi gnas pa'i myang 'das chen por gshegs shing gshegs par 'gyur ba ste/ de la'ang 'bras dus kyi sku dang ye shes kyi rnam pa lam du byed pa'i thabs rim pa gnyis ni lam 'di'i nyams su blang bya'i rtsa ba yin cing de'i gzhi'am rtsa rgyud smin par byed pa la thug pas de nyid sngon du 'gro dgos/ de la'ang dbang*/ byin rlabs/ rig gtad/ bzlas lung ste rnam pa bzhi'i bye brag can du bzhugs pa las/ da lam skabs su babs pa ni/ 'phags yul lho phyogs ra khang tsag+mar sku 'khrungs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon shākya rak+ṣi ta la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su gnang ba'i sgrub thabs brgya dang brgyad yod pa las/ slob dpon pūr+ṇa badz+ra las rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon pos sgrub thabs nyer bzhi gsan pa'i nang tshan 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i bzlas lung sgrub pa ste/ chos 'di gang las brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen shākya rak+ṣi ta/

bud+dha swā mī/ su dzā ta/ sā dhu dzñā na/ saṃ pra kīrti/ bram ze'i slob dpon be dā ban+dhū/ bī ra mi tra/ pūr+ṇa badz+ra/ thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha/ rgyal tshab rin chen rgya mtsho/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ de las kun bzang dbang pos gsan cing*/ yang na/ rgyal tshab ye rgyal nas/ blo gros rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang phrin las/ kun bzang dbang po/ tshe dbang nor bu/ bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta/ kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma/ bka' brgyud phrin las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang dngos pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'i zhal snga nas bka' drin chen pos bstsal ba lags/ de'ang sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'di ni don tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'gros kyis chos thams cad la yang nas yang du dbang bsgyur bar mdzad kyang*/ rnam pa rgyal tshab chen po'i sa la bzhugs pa'i rgyal sras thu bo'i tshul du ston pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi blon po/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shing rta/ chos kyi grong khyer chen po'i sgo srung mos shing mtshan bzung ba tsam gyis srid pa'i chu bo bzhi la sogs 'jigs dang sdug bsngal nyam nga'i gnas mtha' dag las skyob pa/ khyad par smon lam gyi dbang gis dus snyigs ma dang yul mtha' 'khob tu skyes pa'i sems can rmu rgod ltung ba'i rtsa ba chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi ngan 'gro'i sgo gcod pa la 'di dang mtshungs pa gang yang ma mchis pa/ ri mor bris pa'i sku gzugs la mchod pa tsam gyis kyang 'chi khar zhal ston zhing*/ mtho ris dang thar pa la 'god par mdzad pa sogs rnam thar chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam zhing thugs rje tshad ma mchis pa ste/ de lta bu'i sgom bzlas kyi lung sbyin pa la/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug de nas theg pa che chung gi lam gyi sgrub thabs thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs lan gsum/ khyad par du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rig sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams gzhan tu ma yengs par lha'i rnal 'byor 'di bzhin tu bsgom 'tshal/ zhes brda sbyar la/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ khyed rang gi snying gar kham̐/ zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur yan mngon rtogs ltar brjod/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la sngags kyi phreng ba/ mos gus mdzad pas sngags phreng gnyis pa chad de zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du 'khod par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum grub mthar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang*/ khyad par 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus mthu thams cad rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi ngag la thogs med du 'jug par gyur cig 'dir slob dpon dang phreng ba sbrel ba dang mthar phreng ba slob ma'i mgor 'jog pa'ang phyag len tu 'dug des 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i sgom bzlas kyi lung legs par phul grub pa yin pas gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal dang*/ dge bsngo byas pas 'grub bo// 'di ni rgyud sde gang rung gi dbang bskur sngon du thob pa la bya yi/ dbang bskur ma thob pa la bzlas lung mi 'bog go /gsum pa la gnyis/ thun dang thun mtshams kyi bya ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ 'phags pa'i bris sku rab gnas dang ldan pa bkram pa'i mdun du stegs gtsang mar maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu gcig bkod/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal sogs mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor bsham/ dus bzang po la babs pa'i tshe nam langs nas khrus dang gtsang sbra byas te/ 'grub na don zhags nas 'byung ba'i theg chen gso sbyong blangs te/

phyi dro'i kha zas spang ba sogs sdom pa la gnas par bya/ ma 'grub na'ang zas dkar gsum mngar gsum la brten cing spyod lam bag yod pa nges par dgos so// gnyis pa ni/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas pa'am/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ rang gi snying khar kham̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid nam mkha'i snying po sku mdog sngon po na bza' sngon po can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon pas pad+ma'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na ral gri sngo sangs can/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi khang bzang 'od zer sngon po 'bar ba'i dbus na/ khro bo dbyug sngon sogs 'khor rig 'dzin mtshon cha thogs pa mang po dang*/ rang gi sprul pa kha dog sna tshogs can mang pos bskor ba/ spyan gyi 'od kyis nam mkha' thams cad 'od dang dri zhim pos khyab par mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbu rgyun can no// ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ thugs kar zla ba la sngags phreng bkod de/ oṃ swa sti ka mā lāk+ṣi/ bi pu la/ saṃ bha ba/ dharma dhā tu go tsa re swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ thun grol ba na/ lha sku stong par sbyangs la mnyam par bzhag 'jam dpal dpa' bo sogs kyis dge ba bsngo'o// gnyis pa thun mtshams su sku gzugs la mchod bstod smon lam 'debs shing*/ 'di nyid kyi mtshan brgya dang*/ phal po che dang*/ gser 'od dam pa la sogs pa'i theg chen gyi mdo sde bklag par bshad pas/ lag len tu/ sngar bshams pa'i bris sku sogs la rten byas te/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag /sogs dang*/ ma lus sems mgon/ bcom ldan 'dir ni/ ji ltar bltams pa/

srab 'jam yang ba/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs sh+lo ka re re/ de nas 'grub na spang kong phyag brgya pa lta bu'i phyag mchod gnyis sngon du 'gro bas/ gser 'od dam pa nas 'byung ba'i yan lag lhag ma rnams dang*/ yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo mdo sogs snga thun gsham lta bur nyin rer res mos su bklag cing*/ mi nus pa'am/ thun gzhan ma rnams la/ ji snyed su dag nas/ byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis yan lag bdun pa spyir phul/ bye brag tu maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa/ spyod 'jug las byung ba'i rin chen sems de sogs na/ nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /bar gyis mchod la/ phyag sngon du 'gro ba'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod do// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po zhal ras rgya che zhing spyan gyi 'od 'phro bas nam mkha'i dkyil dri zhim par mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha'i spyod yul can sa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang bar mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ swa sti ka mā lāk+ṣi bi pu la sam+bha ba/ dharma dhā tu go tsa re swā hā/ gzungs 'di brjod ma thag tu ngan song dang ngan 'gro thams cad ni rab tu zhi bar gyur/ sa yang g.yos par gyur/ rnga bo che dag gi sgra yang grags par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang legs so zhes bya ba byin no// de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis bka' stsal pa/ kye 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na 'khod pa'i sems can rnams nam mkha'i snying po'i snying po dkyil 'khor mngon sum pa rnams kyi swā hā'i mchog gi gzungs 'byung ba shin tu dka' ba/ bsod nams chen po/ sdig pa dang nyon mongs pa thams cad sreg pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ma/ rin po che'i phung por gyur pa 'di nyon cig dang 'di thos pas dri ma med par 'gyur zhing legs par khrus byas par 'gyur la/ shin tu rnam par dag par 'gyur ro// pad+ma lta bur 'gyur te 'khor ba'i 'dam gyis mi gos so// nyi ma lta bur 'gyur te/

sems can thams cad snang bar byed do// zla ba lta bur 'gyur te/ sems can thams cad rab tu sim par byed do// nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur te/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad kyi mi gos so// sa gzhi lta bur 'gyur te/ mtho dman med do// lhun po lta bur 'gyur te/ sems can thams cad kyis bskyod par mi nus so// thar pa lta bur 'gyur te/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyis mi gos so// de la sogs pa yon tan stong phrag bgrang ba tshad med grangs med pa dag thob par 'gyur te/ nyan pa dang*/ 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ brjod pa dang*/ ston pa tsam dang*/ bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis gang ci'ang rung ste/ de'i 'dod pa dang*/ smon pa dang*/ re ba de dag 'grub par 'gyur ro// bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis kyang char ches pa dang*/ char mi 'bab pa dang*/ sdang bas dkrugs pa dang*/ mi nad dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ gnod pa 'byung ba dang*/ 'jigs pa'i dus dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ chom rkun dang*/ dgon pa dang*/ g.yul 'gyed pa dang*/ gcan gzan dang*/ mu ge'i sdug bsngal rnams las yongs su srung bar byed la/ bde ba dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ ci 'dod pa dang*/ ci la dga' ba thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro// de nas 'khor de dag thams cad kyis ha ha zhes ca co dang ga zha bton te/ sgra ring zhes byas nas gos dang*/ rgyan sna tshogs bskyod de/ snying nas phyag 'tshal nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dbang byed pa 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i bsngags pa rgya mtsho'i bstod pa yang dag par brjod pa/ nam mkha'i snying po srid gsum sems can mchog /'byor ldan blo gros rin chen rgya mtsho mnga'// sems can dag pa bla med rin chen mchog /thar pa'i sa bon 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel// kun mkhyen tshul mkhyen legs dang legs min mkhyen// thar mkhyen chos mkhyen bde dang mi bde mkhyen// lam mkhyen gces mkhyen dge dang mi dge mkhyen// dus mkhyen dge mkhyen stobs dang stobs min mkhyen// 'gro mchog chos mchog sems can yon tan mchog

/lam mchog sngags mchog tshul dang tshul min mchog /rgyan mchog chos mchog 'dzin dang 'dzin min mchog /dag mchog rtogs mchog mchog dang mchog min mchog /zhi rab snying rje'i rab ste 'khor gyi rab// 'od rab thar pa'i rab ste rten gyi rab// rgya rab sngags kyi rab ste thugs brtse'i rab// mnyam rab sems can rab ste gsum rig rab// legs sgron mchog sgron stobs dang stobs min sgron// thar sgron rigs sgron rgyal dang rgyal min sgron// dge sgron gzi sgron nor bu'i 'od kyi sgron// rgyu skar zla ba'i rgyan las shar ba'i sgron// mchog 'od yon tan kun gyi 'od zer 'od// legs 'od thar pa'i pho brang rten gyi 'od// 'od chen gti mug rab tu 'byed pa'i 'od// rdo rje'i 'od 'bar bde ba'i 'od 'char ba// rdo rje'i dbang po 'dren dbang sems can dbang*// rin chen 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgyan dbang po// rgyal dbang rgyal ba'i stobs rgyun tshad med dbang*// dpa' bo rigs sngags 'chang dbang srid gsum dbang*// rdo rje bzang po rdo 'od rdo rje 'bar// rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje 'bar bas brgyan// rdo rje 'od can rdor 'dzin rdo rje grags// rdo rje rgya chen rdo rje rab mchog dbang*// na bza' sngo zhing sku yi cha lugs sngo// sku mdog sngo zhing sngo ba'i 'od kyis brgyan// ral gri rno 'jebs sngo zhing brtan pa bsnams// mkha' sngo gzhal med khang 'bar nang na bzhugs// lha zhal dri med shin tu mi bzad 'bar// rab tu grags la 'od zer 'phro zhing 'gyur// sdig sel rdul ltar 'khrug byed phreng mchog can// glog gi stobs kyis snang bas sgeg la brtan// ral gri mtshon thogs dbang ldan mthu stobs mtshon// rdo rje'i mtshon thogs mda' dang mdung thung 'jigs// 'khor lo'i mtshon thogs bcibs pa ri dang 'khrul// gsal shing mtshon thogs bgegs kyis stobs 'joms pa// bde 'byung 'jig rten gsum bdag rdo rje'i dbyug

/sku rnams thams cad nyi ma'i 'od kyis brgyan// grags pa'i rigs su byung bas rgyal po mdzad// mu tig phreng bas sgeg cing mdzes par bgyis// sku mdzes brnyes shing phun sum tshogs pa brnyes// rab 'byams mchog brnyes sa la 'jug pa brnyes// mthu stobs lhag pa brnyes shing grub brnyes la// rig pa gsum gyi stobs brnyes mthu brnyes pa// bde 'dren zhi ba 'dren cing 'od 'dren pa// cha lugs gsal mchog dar ba chen po 'dren// byams 'dren nyi ma 'dren cing skye dgu 'dren// legs 'dren zhig gi stobs 'dren snying rje can// dri med cha lugs gsal ba cha lugs 'bar// rnam grags sgeg pas grags pa'i ba dan can// 'gro ba'i skabs 'byed 'jug dang ldog pa mkhyen// longs spyod gsal bar ston pa'i sems kyis 'jug /sku dmar sku mthon sku mdzes sku bzang ba// sku ser sku dkar dar ba chen po'i sku// sku rol rdo rje'i sku mnga' spyan legs sku// rigs sku rig sngags 'chang ba rin chen bsnams// gtsug gi nor bu gtsug can cod pan mchog /cod pan can te chos 'dzin rdo rje mchog /dpal 'dzin rin chen dam pa 'chang ba'i mchog /sngags gzhi phyag rgya 'chang ba phun sum tshogs// rab mdzes mkha' la gshegs shing rab tu rgyu// srid gsum nyi ma gcig pu 'od stong mnga'// re rtser 'char ba bdal legs bkra shis pa// yon tan mthu stobs khyad par rnam par grags// nor bu chen po nor sdug nor bu'i 'od// nyi ma'i nor bu tshul spyod nor bu 'bar// yid bzhin nor bu 'gro kun mgon cig pu// nam mkha'i dkyil na nor bu gcig snang ba// sems can rnam dag yangs shing rnam par grags// srid gsum srung ma gcig pu rgyal sras mchog /zhi ba rab tu zhi ba skyabs 'os rtag /skye dgu'i bdag po pad byung pad+ma skyes// kun nas 'od bzang legs bshad chos mnga' ba// dar ba legs bshad rab dul legs bshad phyag

/blo bzang 'od bzang bde ldan skye gnas bzang*// mkhas rab zhi rab mchog gi chos dang ldan// zhi mdzad rgyal 'byung bde ba 'byung ba'i gnas// 'od kyi 'byung gnas bde mdzad dbang du mdzad// legs 'byung shes rab 'byung gnas stobs skyes pa// snying rje'i 'byung gnas blo bzang rnam grags mdzad// rnam grol nges grol shin tu grol ba'i blo// blo yangs rnam par bkram zhing rnam par grags// kun tu longs spyod sgo ste blo yi mchog /blo gros brtan pa dkon mchog gsum las bsgrubs// sangs rgyas pad+ma 'dab rgyas 'dra ba'i zhal// dag cing spyan yangs cha lugs yid du 'thad// snying po gsal ba'i snying po brtan zhing dul// ngo bo nyid kyi rgyun brnyes rab gsal ba// spyan zur mda' ni rab tu gtad legs pa// 'jigs med zhal ras ston gyi zla ba 'dra// mdung thung brgya yi mtshon mchog mtshon cha rdzogs// drag po 'jigs pa sdig sel gsum las skyes// rab dul mkhas pa 'grogs dga' 'dris par sla// rab tu grags pa gnyen rab gser mdog can// lha chen bde byed gsal shing phyag na bsnams// spyan gsum rig pa gsum ldan me gsum sel// 'dod bzang me tog mtshon thogs me tog mda'// na bza' bzang mnabs g.yas 'phen tshabs cher 'phen// legs bris sna tshogs mtshon cha sna tshogs mda'// na bza' sna tshogs sna tshogs rgyan gyi dpal// zhal ras zla ba 'od zer rgyas pa 'dra// zhal mdangs bstan pas 'jig rten kun 'byor mdzad// bzhad pa nyi ma'i 'od zer rab 'jebs mnga'// zhal mdangs rgya mtsho gsal mdzad lam me ba// dbang chen rdo rje'i thog lags 'jigs pa'i sgra// rdo rje drag po nor bu g.yo ba 'dzin// sgra snyan snang bar mdzad pa'i mthu dang ldan// blo gros chen po blo gros rno ba'i mchog /rgyun 'dzin dpal 'dzin rin chen zhal dang ldan// rgyu dang mi rgyu 'gro ba kun gyi gnas// de bzhin gshegs pa mgon sras phreng ba bzang*// stobs chen 'jig rten blo gros ngo bo nyid// skye dgu'i bdag po bka' lung mnyam zhing brtags// mi yi mnga' bdag mtho ris skyes pa'i rgyu// sgyu 'dra 'dod pa'i mda' dang rdo rje can// mthu stobs mnga' zhing spyan bzang sdug par ldan// ston pa bzang po stong nyid lam gyi stegs// gces gsum 'phel ba'i rgyu la 'jug pa mdzad// brtan po rgyu la rab tu nges gyur pa// dkyil 'khor dam pa kun gyi slob dpon lags// gcig pu skye dgu'i dkyil 'khor cho ga mkhyen// rnam par snang mdzad zhing gi gnas nas skyes// dbang bskur brnyes shing sa bcur legs par gnas// gnas chen son pa mchog gnas gcig pu lags// skye dgu rnams kyi nyon mongs sel ba dang*// sdig 'joms mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad 'di thos nas// bde gshegs sras mchog su zhig 'don byed pa// 'jig rten zla ba gcig shar bzhin tu snang*// nam mkha'i snying po sems can gcig pu yi// mdun 'dug nangs par bstod pa 'di brjod gang*// de ni srid gsum sems can mchog 'gyur zhing*// dri ma'i gnas kun las kyang thar bar 'gyur// g.yul dang 'thab rtsod shin tu mi bzad dang*// mu ge'i gnod pa mi nad byung ba na// mkhas pa su zhig sngar langs dad bskyed nas// nam mkha'i snying po la ni bstod byed pa// de ni 'jigs pa'i 'byung gnas thams cad dang*// sdug bsngal 'byung 'dren sdig pa rnams las grol// de ni zhi mchog mchog bde kun gnas dang*// bde ba rgya chen nges par thob par gyur// bde thob longs spyod 'phel bar bya ba'am// rgyal srid 'thob dang byad gzugs nor 'thob dang*// rigs 'thob yon tan kun gyi gzhi bsgrub phyir// bton na 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// de phyir ji ste rtag tu 'dod bde kun// 'dod na 'gro ba kun la gcig dpa' ba// nam mkha'i snying po srid gsum mgon po la// rtag tu bsten cing sngags kyang bstan par bgyi// zhes pa'i mthar/

bzang spyod/ byams smon/ spyod 'jug smon lam sogs rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba res mos su bya/ bzod gsol/ brtan bzhugs sam gshegs gsol dag kyang mdo chog las 'byung ba ltar mdor bsdus tsam bya zhing bkra shis sh+lo ka gsum re tsam brjod do// klog pa la spro na thun mtshams su mdo sde ci nus kyang bklag go /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje zhal nas/ deng sang rmi lam zhal lta'i cho ga byed pa la bsnyen pa sngon tu 'gro dgos zhes gsungs pas 'di lta bu'i tshul gyis bsnyen pa 'bum phrag ma mthar byas pa nges par 'grub dgos so// bzhi pa la gnyis/ thun bzhi'i rim pas bshags pa dang*/ rmi lam du bshags pa'o// dang po ni/ mdo las/ gal te sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i ming thos nas mthong bar 'dod cing ngan song du ltung bas 'jigs te/ ltung ba'i rtsa ba bshags par 'dod na gal te de dag byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal zhing de'i ming nas brjod na/ rigs kyi bu de dag gi skal pa ji lta ba bzhin tu/ sems can de'i mdun tu tha mal pa'i tshul du 'dug pa'am/ bram ze'i gzugs nas/ bu mo'i gzugs kyi bar gyis byang chub sems dpa' las thog ma pa de'i mdun du 'dug ste/ ltung ba'i rtsa ba de ji ltar byung ba bshags su 'jug go /de'i thabs mkhas pa zab mo dang*/ bla na med pa'i theg pa chen po la spyod pa yang ston/ sa dang sa dag tu yang ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzungs dang*/ bzod pa la gzhog par byed de/ rim gyis lam yan lag brgyad pa'i bar gyis gzhog par byed do// zhes gsungs pa'i don nyams su len pa na/ dkon mchog sprin la sogs pa mdo sde'i don 'phags pa thogs med kyi zhal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ sdig pa so sor bshags pa dang*/

rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ bskul ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ yongs su bsngo ba rnams kyang bya'o// zhes gsungs pa 'di lta bu la brten nas ltung ba bshags shing*/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed dgos pas/ bsnyen pa sngon du song nas sku gzugs mchod pa maṇ+ḍal sogs bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar bsham/ a ka ru dang rgya spos sogs sbyar ba'i spos mang po dang khrus chab sogs 'du byas/ gos gtsang ma bgo /nam langs pa dang*/ oṃ pra kṛ ta pa ri shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥpra kṛ ta pa ri shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas khrus chab byin gyis brlabs la yan lag lnga khrus bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sa gzhi byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ khrus gsol sku phyi na bza' 'bul ba yan chad mdo lugs chos spyod nang ltar thun dang po la rgyas pa dang*/ gzhan la ji ltar 'os pa bya/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa dang bzhi pa lta bus dkon mchog spyi la phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po zhal ras rgya che zhing sogs mtshan brgya'i dbu nas 'byung ba'i phyag 'tshal de'i gsham du 'phags pa bdag la zhal bstan te sdig pa dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes btags pas phyag brgya rtsa re 'tshal/ mgyogs khyad 'dod na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i gsham du gsol gdab btags kyang rung*/ spos btul/ me tog la sogs pas mchod/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum dang*/ rin chen sems de sogs kyis mchod/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas par 'bul/ ltung bshags tshar gsum/ gser 'od las 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis/ srid 'gror nyam ngar sogs/ spyod 'jug las byung ba/ gtso bo rgyal ba/ jo bo rje'i bshags chog tu byung ba/ bla ma rdor 'dzin sogs lan gsum mthar/ rjes su yi rang nas bsngo ba'i bar gyi yan lag chos spyod ltar bya/ nam snying gi mtshan brgya tshar gcig mthar gzungs sngags 'di ji tsam nus pa bzla'o// tad+ya thā/

su mṛ sha su mṛ sha kā ru ṇi ka tsa ra tsa ra/ bi tsa ra/ saṃ tsa ra/ kā ru ṇi ka mu ra mu ra/ bi ga dha ri ma tsa ma/ bhu dza sā da kā ru ṇi ka tsin+dha ma ṇi pū ra ya kā ru ṇi ka sarba sha me s+thā pā ya adzñā dha ri/ s+phu gung s+phu gung*/ ru ti bi be ka gung*/ dṛṣ+ṭi bi be ka gung*/ pū ra ya kā ru ṇi ka pū ra yan+tu ma ma ā sha ya/ sarba san+tha tsa a sho ka ga ti swā hā/ gzungs bzla ba la sogs pa'i tshe spos btul ba ma chad par bya/ mthar gong du smos pa'i phyag lan gsum dang*/ dgongs shig dgongs shig thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ grags pa chen po nam mkha'i snying po 'gro ba'i don bzhed pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag la gzigs shig bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can ltung ba'i rtsa ba byung ba/ ngan song du 'gro ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sprugs par byed pa/ 'jig par byed pa'i sems can ma rig pa'i mun nag dang*/ lta ba ngan pas sdug bsngal bar gyur pa rnams kyi ltung ba'i rtsa ba yongs su dag nas snying gi the tshom bral bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag la sogs pa snying gi snod tshogs par gyur pa/ ltung ba'i dngos por gyur pa/ phas pham pa'i sems can dge ba'i chos thams cad zhig par gyur pa/ ngan song du 'gro ba/ mgon med pa/ rten med pa/ mkhas pa thams cad kyis spangs pa rnams kyi sdig pa'i dri ma 'khrud nas 'gro ba ngan pa'i lam las bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam na'ang rung*/ sad pa'i tshe'ang rung ste skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i sku gzugs kyi snang ba bstan nas bdag cag gi ltung ba 'chags su 'jug cing dag tshangs kyi bka' drin bstsal du gsol/ thabs mkhas pas mngon sum du lam drang ba'i thabs kyis ston te/ thabs des lta ba ngan par byed pa/ smon lam ngan pa'i bsam pa dang skyabs ngan pa dang*/ ngan par 'jug pa'i sems las myur du thar bar mdzad du gsol/ ci nas kyang bdag gi lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sbyor ba drang por 'gyur ba dang*/

smon lam drang po dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen drang po bsten par 'gyur ba dang*/ myur du dri ngan pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ sdig pa'i lta ba las yongs su thar bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag gi ngan song du 'gro ba'i lam thams cad/ smon lam gyi dbang dang*/ legs par spyod pa'i las kyi myur du byang bar mdzad du gsol/ myur du bdag cag gi sems la dbang thob pa dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa zab mo dang*/ bla na med pa'i theg pa chen po la spyod cing phyir mi ldog pa dang*/ sa dang*/ sa dag tu yang ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzungs dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la rdo rje bzhin du mthu che zhing*/ brtul ba brtan pos myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu gdab/ bzod gsol/ brtan bzhugs sam gshegs gsol/ bsngo smon gang 'os chos spyod ltar bya/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis thun bzhi dang*/ khyad par thor thun la rtse gcig tu bya/ thun mtshams gang rigs su bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar sgom bzlas khyug tsam re'ang ma chag par grub na legs so// gnyis pa ni/ mdo las/ gal te de bdag la mngon sum du ston par mi byed na/ gang de la gsol bar byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' las thog ma pa nyes pa dang bcas pas tho rangs kyi thun la langs te/ kha shar phyogs su bstan te 'dug la/ lha'i bu skya rengs la gsol ba gdab par bya/ zhes dang*/ bslab btus las/ rmi lam 'phags pa nam snying gi /mdun du 'dug ste bshags par bya// zhes pas thor thun gyi gsham du/ snga na skya rengs dang po dang*/ phyi na skya rengs tha ma shar ba'i tshe khang steng la sogs pa bla gab med pa'i sar phyin la spos btul/ phyag 'tshal gsol gdab kyi bsham can phyogs bcu la lan bcu bya/ mthar kha shar du phyogs/ pus btsugs thal mo sbyar te/ skya rengs skya rengs thugs rje chen po can/

skal ba chen po can khyod 'dzam bu'i gling du shar ma thag tu/ bdag la thugs rjes dgab par mdzod cig byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po thugs rje chen po can la bdag gi tshig gis sgron te/ bdag gi rmi lam du yang de ston par 'gyur zhing*/ gang gi thabs des ltung ba bshags par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'phags pa'i theg pa chen po la thabs dang ye shes kyi mig chen po thob par mdzod cig ces brjod la mal du 'ongs nas gzungs sngags brjod bzhin gnyid du log pas rab zhag gcig gam gsum/ 'bring bdun/ tha ma bskyar bldabs lan gsum gyis skal ba dang 'tshams par/ sku dngos sam/ bla ma'am/ pha ma la sogs pa'i gzugs ston pa la bshags pa byed du bstsal zhing*/ dag byed kyi thabs ston pa de la the tshom mi bya bar lag tu len par bya'o// lnga pa la lnga las/ dang po sku gzugs mchod pa ni/ nges par bris sku'am/ lug sku byas la/ gzungs sngags ma gtogs pa bshags pa'i cho ga ltar ram/ nyin bzhin dad mos rtse gcig pas phyag mchod ma chad par phul na/ me chu mtshon dug sogs dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung*/ tshe zad pa ma gtogs nad gdon gyi 'tshe ba mi 'byung*/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du ltung ba'i rtsa ba mi 'byung*/ bkres skom dang rgyal po'i chad pa la sogs pa'ang mi 'byung zhing*/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab ste nang dbugs gnas pa'i skabs su rang gi mos pa gang la che ba'i gzugs su sprul nas chos ston te sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i zhing du lam sna 'dren par gsungs so// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar 'dod pas cho ga sngar ltar la/ gzungs sngags bzla ba la bab pa'i tshe/ dgongs shig dgongs shig nam mkha'i snying po thugs rje chen po brnyes pa bdag la dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor stsol cig lan gsum mam bdun/ tad+ya thā/ u mu ra na khe/ pak+ṣ+ma nī le/ sa mu dra/ a ba ta ra na/ na ya na ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka

a nu sa dzam+bha smṛ te/ a gra dzam+bha smṛ te/ badz+ra dzam+bha smṛ te/ ko ṣa smṛ ti/ a nu sa ma smṛ ti/ bud+dha ko ṭi smṛ te swā hā/ zhes bzla/ gsum pa chos la gzungs thob par 'dod na/ gzugs sngags kha bsgyur/ dgongs shig dgongs shig mkhas pa chen po sems can thams cad kyi nang na bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rigs kyi bu nam mkha'i snying po gang zag gi mchog dran pa dang ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor bdag la stsol cig gsum mam bdun/ tad+ya thā/ i nī la dza/ bi ṣan du ṣa dza/ bi ya ba na dza/ bi bak+ṣi sa me/ pā sha la dzā si/ s+thā na sha ra be/ shās+t+ra kar+ṇen/ hu ma hu ma/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka swā hā/ bzhi pa nad dang dbul phongs chad pa 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs pa zhi bar 'dod na/ cho ga sngar ltar la/ mtshan brgya dang gzungs ci nus su bklag pa'i mthar/ dgongs shig dgongs shig thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ grags pa chen po nam mkha'i snying po 'gro ba'i don bzhed pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag la gzigs shig bdag 'di lta bu las rab tu thar bar mdzod cig skal ba mdzod cig mthu chen po bdag ni sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag go /shin tu dbul lo// bdag ni khyod la gnas nas/ zhi ba dang bde ba 'di dang tshe rabs gzhan tu 'thob par 'gyur bar mdzod cig ces lan bdun la sogs pa brjod do// lnga pa chos kyi gdan sa/ 'jig rten gyi rgyal srid dang*/ phyug po la sogs pa gnas chen po 'thob par 'dod pas/ cho ga dang mtshan brgya gzungs bcas kyi mthar/ nam mkha'i snying po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag la skal ba stsol cig bsam pa dang*/ sems pa thams cad dang*/ bsam pa yid bzhin rab tu rdzogs par mdzod cig gang sems shing gang gsol ba thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyod kyis mdzod cig ces gsol ba lan mang du gdab bo// de dag kyang khrus dang*/ gtsang sbra byas/ dad mos kyi shugs chen pos gsol ba rtse gcig tu gdab/ mchod pa'i bye brag ci 'byor pas mchod/

dus bzhi dang khyad par tho rangs kyi thun la nan tan tu 'bad pa bsngags so// ka ye/ las ngan gyi 'bras bus 'phangs pa'i snyigs ma'i lus sdug bsngal brgya yis brgyan pa'i byis pa bsod nams chung ba dag gis nor bu bor nas mching bu tshol ba ltos/ de 'dra ba la 'dod pa'i don yid la 'bab pa dag gang gi phyir 'jo// dbang chen po thob pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po dus thung ngus zhal lta ba'i sgrub thabs de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa 'di la yid ches pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa ni su zhig yod/ lag tu len nus pa'i bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa'ang nam gyi dus su 'byung bar 'gyur zhig gu/ 'di ltar 'bri ba rnyed pa'ang sangs rgyas kyi mthu ste byang chub sems kyi nus pas bsod nams kyi blo gros thang 'ga' 'byung rigs pas so// tshul 'di la rnam gzhag rgyas pa dag kyang spro bar rigs mod/ rje bla ma kun mkhyen chen pos kyang 'dus la gsal bar gyis shig pa'i bka' bstsal pa dang*/ rje btsun kun dga' snying pos/ smra mang yi ge gdams pas dben// rnyed pa'i lcags kyu ya mtshan rmad// gzhan tu mi dbang tshig gcig gis// grong khyer yul 'khor bcas mnga' bdag /ces gsungs pa bzhin dgos ched sogs 'bud tsam las ma smos pa zad do// yang smras pa// mthu chen sras po yid bzhin nor// bsten las 'dod pa kun 'jo yang*// nyes pa gtsang byed ke ta ka /nam mkha'i snying po mtshungs gzhan med// dpa' rnams thugs rje nyam nga ba'i// yul la 'jug pa chos nyid phyir// bdag 'dra ltung ldan gang zag gis// bsgrub bya'i snying po 'di yin no// deng sang chos ltar bcos pas gang*// chos min sna tshogs 'bad nas 'chad// dam chos rtswa ltar dor nas su// ltar snang chos la yi dam 'cha'// sangs rgyas byang sems yal bar 'dor// gdug pa'i 'byung po skyabs su bsten// mi dge'i 'bras bu bde bar re// rtsa ltung spyod cing 'dren par rloms// kye ma snyigs ma'i dus ngan 'dir// mkhas pa'i legs bshad than du lta// blun po'i rang bzo srog ltar btsa'// bstan pa'i nyi ma nub rir phyogs// des na nyam chung bdag 'dra'i tshig

/su la phan par 'gyur dka' yang*// dam chos yin nges 'di dag la// mos 'dun bzod du med pas bris// khams dang dbang po sna tshogs shing*// gzur gnas chos kyi spyan ldan kyang*// 'byung 'gyur srid mtha' ma bkag pas// dran gso tsam du'ang 'gyur ram snyam// sangs rgyas sras bcas byin rlabs dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag mthus// ltung ldan gang zag ji snyed pa// 'di la brten nas ldang nus shog /de las thar pa'i lam po che// grong khyer chen po'i lam srol bzhin// shin tu yangs par gyur nas kyang*// 'brel tshad don dang ldan gyur cig /bstan pa'i rgya mtsho mi 'grib 'phel zhing brtan// de srid chos 'di'i chu klung zhing kun tu// chad med 'bab pas sdig ltung dri kun bkrus// thub pa'i bstan la sri zhu'i mchog gyur shog /ces pa'i tshul 'di'ang rang nyid kyi 'di ltar nyams len bgyis pa'i skabs su phyin chad bsnyel gso dang*/ skal mnyam re re tsam la'ang phan tu re bas 'bri bar 'dod pa'i tshe/ kun gzigs thugs rje'i mnga' bdag mañdzu gho ṣa'i zhal snga nas cis kyang bgyi bar 'os so zhes pa'i bka' bstsal gtsug tu mchod de/ byams mgon tā'i si tu'i bka' 'bangs tha shal pa rmongs brtul blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du bris pa bstan 'gror phan bde'i snang ba 'dren pa'i shing rta mchog tu gyur cig sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rgyal sras nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam thar phyogs gcig gi cha shas la cung zad bsngags pa nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po sems can gyi bsam pa dang spyod pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrogs pa'i sprin gyi char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na ma ā kā sha gar+bhā ya/ chos kyi rgyal po dus gsum gshegs pa'i blon// chos kyi mdzod kyi sgo srung gcig pu pa// skyes bu chen po nam mkha'i snying po zhes// rgyal sras dbus na u dum+ba ra de// dus dang phyogs su 'byung ba dkon pa'i mchog

/nam mkha' chu yi rlangs pa bral ba'i ngos// nyi ma'i snying po chags dang thogs med pa// snang ba'i dam pas 'gro la phan btags kyang*// rgyags dang drin la lan gyi 'dod med de// dmus long dmig bu med pa ma gtogs par// de yi snang ba phyogs su lhung mi 'gyur// gang blo shes rab nam mkha'i rang bzhin la// thabs mkhas snying po dus kun gang byung ba// gcig tu bsdus kyang rlom pa'i sems med pa// thugs rje chen po de yang de bzhin te// log sred can min skye ba bzhir skyes pa// byang chub lam du 'dren pa'i shing rta mchog /chos kyi dbyings su rtogs pa'i rin thang can// thams cad khyod kyi dge ba'i gter la chud// phongs pa rnams kyi bum pa bzang po ste// dge rtsa'i 'bras bu skyed pa'i sa yang yin// 'dun dang dran pas drangs pa'i bslab pa yi// lhun po'i gtos su byang sems chos kun gzhol// shes bya'i chos su gyur pas mi phyed pas// chos kun bzod pa'i rdo rje'i go chas g.yogs// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi thogs par// brtson 'grus rlung shugs 'khor 'das kun tu g.yo// sems can don byed ting 'dzin bye ba'i klung*// ting 'dzin rgya mtsho'i 'jing la sdud cing spro// gnas chen po sogs dam pa ci 'dod pa// slong la dngos kun ster ba'i yongs 'dus ljon// 'tsho ba'i yo byad bde bar gnas rnams dang*// mi mthun 'jigs las skyob pa'i rdzong btsan mchog /lam zhugs so so'i rang bzhin tha dad pa// ye shes nam mkha' yangs pas go 'byed cing*// sangs rgyas chos rnams gang la brten pa'i gnas// rang rgyal 'jug ldog bgrang ba'i phreng ba ste// nyan thos rnams la bslab pa'i gos bzang nyid// pha rol phyin pa rnams kyi 'bras bu'i bcud// sa bcu brnyes pa'i tshogs kyi yid bzhin nor// dpa' bar 'gro ba rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i shing*// lta ba'i drwa ba gcod pa'i rno mtshon te// bag chags mtshams sbyor dral ba'i ral gri dang*// thabs chen rnams la chos kyi grangs su gyur// lha yi mig ste mi rnams kyi ni lam// dud 'gro'i 'jigs skyob yi dwags rnams kyi zas// sems dmyal mgon te sbyin gnas rnams kyi snod// nad la rkyen sman bkres pa rnams kyi 'bru// skom la chu shel ngal ba rnams kyi mal// snyoms 'jug ldan la nyi ma'i nor bu mchog

/bslab pa 'khrugs pa rnams kyi mig 'byed cing*// sdom pa spyod rnams bzhin ras mthong ba'i snod// sgro skur tshig gis gdung la grib ma'i gdugs// dge rtsa chad de ltung ba'i 'khar ba nyid// mun la nyi dang lam stor rnams kyi zla// khrel dang ngo tshas gcer ba rnams kyi gos// rgol ba'i glang po 'joms pa'i gdong lnga pa// bdud kyi dgra la dpa' ba'i dpung chen po// mtho ris skas ka pha rol 'gro ba'i gru// mya ngan brgal te phyin pa'i zam pa de// de bzhin gshegs pa nyag gcig ma gtogs pa// dbang thob rgyal ba'i myu gu sogs pas kyang*// mchod cing ri mor bya ba'i gnas yin zhes// dpal gyi mgur las bsngags pa'i sil snyan dkrol// skyabs ngan la bsten lta ba'i thibs 'og tu// chud nas mtho ris thar pa'i skabs bral ba// gal te khyod mtshan thos nas mos byed na// bag la nyal dang bsam pa des gzigs te// gang la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'am// sbyin sogs bsod nams bya ba'i dngos gcig gis// dge ba'i bshes kyi lam nas dbang thob cing*// spyod dang smon la bsam pa drang ba yis// lta gyur g.yang sa bye ba las zlog pa// pra se na yi gsal snang bzhin du ston// mthong ba nyams dang lce bcings gyur pa sogs// gdon dang 'du ba 'khrugs pas gtses rnams kyang*// mos pa'i rdzing bu khyod phyir bgrung pa la// brgya byin bram ze sman pa'i gzugs shar te// sbyor ba gcig gis phan pa brgya phrag bstsal// bzo gnas 'tsho ba rigs dang nor gyi dbyig /dbang phyug grangs sogs nye bar spyod rnams dang*// thos dang dben las skyes pa'i bsam gtan gyi// bde ba'i yongs su spyad pa bsgrub pa'am// 'gro mang sdug bsngal rgyu dang phral 'dod cing*// byang chub spyod la 'jug pa'i blo chen pos// gzhan phan ched du bdag nyid bzhugs rnams kyang*// gang la dad pa'i snying chus bran pa yi// mig gi ut+pal gsar du 'bus pa la// 'phags pas skal bar 'tshams pa'i gzugs bstan te// skye bo bye ba khrag khrig thabs gcig gis// smin par nus pa'i gdams ngag chen po 'bogs// lam la zhugs dang theg pa'i gzhon pa can// rang 'bras khyim du 'bad pas bgrod byed pa// de dag phyir mi ldog pa'i grong khyer du// skad cig yud la cung zad rtsol bas gzhog

/lhag pa'i bsam pas nan tan 'gros ldan zhing*// lta ba ma 'khyogs rgyags dang g.yo med par// de la grags pa chen po thugs brtse ste// mthu dang brtson 'grus brtul ba brtan po yi// bzang po spyod pa'i pha rol phyin la bkod// rgyud med smra dang phyi ma mi 'tshal zhing*// chog mi shes dang rmongs pa'i mun par 'thim// khro sogs kun dkris chen pos zag bcas kyi// dge rtsa thams cad dkrugs par bgyid pa dang*// mos pa'i snying gi snod chag phas pham pas// ltung ba'i dngos las ldang bar ma nus pa// mkhas pas spangs pa'i rgyal blon nyan thos dang*// rgyal ba'i rgyud du dang por skyes pa rnams// sdig sems gzugs brnyan chu srin khros pa'i khar// las kyi rlung gi bdas las phyir ldon te// ngan par 'gro ba'i lam gyi rgyun gcod cing*// dkar po'i chos snod zhig pa slar la 'tshos// de dag phyir du dge
